difficultyRationale: Checks the exact behavior of String.repeat, including that it repeats the whole receiver.
explanation: `String.repeat(3)` concatenates three copies of the receiver string, so `ab` becomes `ababab`.

options.explanation: repeat does not append the count.
The entire string is repeated each time; characters are not grouped.

options.text: It throws IllegalArgumentException for counts greater than 1.
